propositions: A plan that schedules recurring or automatic work behind a specific CI provider trigger (e.g., GitHub Actions only) with no operation-linked or in-process fallback is not portable and breaks when deployed to projects using a different CI provider or no CI provider at all.

The project portability criterion's detection text must name both 'CI under any provider' and 'projects with NO CI provider at all' as distinct, nameable alternate shapes in the Platform and venue matrix cell.

The portability criterion rubric, its documentation mirror, and agent guidance must carry a consistent rule stating that a capability whose only trigger is a specific CI system requires an operation-linked or in-process fallback, or it is a portability finding.
Detection of CI-only hard dependencies must fire a project.portability finding when reviewed, naming the no-CI-provider alternate shape and the observable breakage (the capability never executes).
The criterion detection text is the authoritative wording; docs/plan-review-gate.md mirrors it, and AGENTS.md points to both the criterion and the rebar explain surface without restating rubric text.
